opportunities.description:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/Grainlify/grainlify-bounty-agent/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
Record the real network fee in the ledger, not only the capped estimate

**The problem**

When the agent pays for inference over x402, the Solana network fee is most of what the call costs — in our measurements a paid call cost $0.002031, of which $0.002004 was the network fee. So the fee is the number most worth getting right.

The signer already knows exactly what the fee was: `res.feeLamports`, taken from the confirmed transaction. It converts that to micro-USD using `solUsdCeilingPrice`, a deliberately high fixed SOL price ($400) chosen so the budget can never under-count spend.

That conversion is the only thing kept. `inference_calls` stores `fee_micro` and no lamports, so the ledger reports a conservative estimate and the exact figure is thrown away.

**Where in the code**

- `services/signer/src/signer.ts` — `PayResult` carries `fee_lamports`; look for `lamportsToMicroCeil(res.feeLamports, ...)`.
- `packages/x402/src/client.ts` — the settle call that records the payment drops `fee_lamports`.
- `db/migrations/` — add a new forward-only migrat

opportunities.title: [Bounty: $70] Stop silently skipping ledgers when INDEXER_START_LEDGER is raised
opportunities.description:
## Context

`supabase/functions/_shared/checkpoint.ts:68-70` computes `from = max(lastProcessedLedger + 1, startLedger)`. Once a checkpoint exists, raising `INDEXER_START_LEDGER` (or `indexer_checkpoints.start_ledger`) jumps `from` forward and silently skips every ledger in between, with no log, warning, or alert, carving a permanent invisible gap.

## Proposed Change

Use `startLedger` only when there is no checkpoint; when a checkpoint exists and `startLedger > checkpoint + 1`, ignore it or fail/log a warning and raise an alert.

## Acceptance Criteria

- With a checkpoint present, `computeLedgerRange` never advances past `lastProcessedLedger + 1` because of a higher `startLedger`
- A test covers a raised `startLedger` and asserts a warning/failure rather than a silent skip
- The documented rebuild procedure still works

**Suggested Label:** correctness
**ETA:** 48 hours

Owner: @hulh122. Areas: billing, subscriptions, usage packs, and credits; IM integrations (Slack, Discord, Feishu, Telegram, Teams, AgentPhone).

This is part of the API transaction reduction effort. ## Purpose

Canonical coordination issue for concurrent ChatGPT/Codex/agent work under the Multi-Thread Collaboration & Publication v2 control.

## Rule

- Research and evidence work may proceed in parallel.
- Only one active integration/publication lane may exist at a time.
- Worker threads do not independently publish, merge, or create competing continuity universes; they return structured deltas tied to canonical IDs and task issues.
- An integration lane is represented by one current-main-based `integration/` or expressly designated integration PR.
- If an integration PR is already active, other related threads remain workers and feed deltas into this queue or linked task issues.
- Pre-control open PRs are preserved as legacy backlog until explicitly reactivated, reconciled, superseded or closed.

## Worker delta minimum

`task / canonical IDs / sources / corrections / new propositions / open gaps / proposed files or routes / conflicts with current main / readiness`

## Publication rule

One logical release should normally produce one integration PR. Deterministic generated artifacts must be created before merge and CI should verify them rather than mutate `main` after merge. P

A review of the 74 existing tickets found that nothing owns the core of the product: **choosing and testing the actual trading / prediction algorithms.** The completed #70–#75, #111, #119–#128 work builds market-state descriptors (EWMA, CUSUM, Kalman, PELT, BOCPD, ATR, PCA, correlation, HMM, mark/trade, OI/funding, taker flow).
